name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either 7 ly goes with Algae or Eklund goes with Plankton.
Cho, Eklund, and Fontaine go with 5 ly, 6 ly, and 8 ly, in some order.
Algae, Basalt, and Regolith go with Bauer, Eklund, and Fontaine, in some order.
Either Cho goes with 8 ly or 5 ly goes with Fontaine.
Exactly one of these is true: Bauer goes with Basalt; Cho goes with 6 ly; Regolith goes with 8 ly.

So Cho does not go with Algae.
